title: hello
description: Phone to hub, the first message the phone sends on a new connection. The token is not here: it travels in the upgrade request's `Authorization: Bearer` header, so the hub refuses a wrong token before any message is read.

protocol.description: The protocol version the phone speaks. The phone speaks exactly one major.

capabilities.description: The protocol features the phone can use. The hub answers with the subset it will use and ignores names it does not know. Known in v1.0: `descriptors` (the hub sends Bucket Descriptors), `corpus` (the phone uploads its Corpus: `turn_offer`, `turn_audio`, `turn_ack`), and `summaries` (the hub summarises a capture Bucket's Notes: `summarize`, answered by `reply`).
